record.question: Considering the following statement choose the correct one:
options: A saturated solution is one in which no more solute can be dissolved at a constant temperature.
A dilute solution is formed when a saturated solution is heated and its ability to dissolve solute increases.
A concentrated solution contains much more solvent than solute.
A saturated solution contains solvent less than or nearly equal to the amount of solute.
